site_name: Drumshangie / East Airdrie (former Drumshangie opencast mine and Drumshangie Moss)
address: Land northeast of Airdrie, north of Plains, extending toward Greengairs, North Lanarkshire

site_area_m2.claimant: Shepherd Chartered Surveyors (selling agent, on behalf of landowner)
site_area_m2.notes: 117.21 ha (289.63 acres) per sale particulars for the marketed Digital/Data Centre & Manufacturing Campus. The wider Albert Bartlett East Airdrie landholding is c.383.27 ha per the July 2024 EIA NTS for the separate mixed-use application.

gross_floor_area_m2.notes: 'Over 1.2 million sq ft' total floorspace marketed for the whole campus (data centres, gigafactory, research, offices, BESS) — not data centre floorspace alone. Converted at 1.2M sq ft = 111,484 m2.

current_land_use: Largely vacant restored/disturbed former opencast land, moss/peatland and rough grazing
previous_land_use: Opencast and deep coal mining (Drumshangie Mine and surrounding pits; mining in the wider Greengairs area from the 1840s to the late 20th century)
protected_designations: Drumshangie Moss North SINC (within/adjacent to wider landholding)
Drumshangie Moss: Dykehead (South) SINC (within/adjacent to wider landholding)
Stanrigg Memorial (non-statutory heritage feature within/adjacent to site)
land_notes: Described by APRS and the applicant's EIA as brownfield (ex-opencast, historic mining disturbance), but the land includes Drumshangie Moss peatland with organic soils/peat recorded on site, so it is recorded here as mixed. The site encompasses the location of the 1918 Stanrigg pit disaster: 19 miners died when peat moss inrushed the Arbuckle Pit; 11 bodies were never recovered and remain entombed, with a memorial c.100 m from the accident site. NLC LDP 2022 allocated parts of the landholding as NLC00520 (Data Centre, Greengairs Road, 65.30 ha) and NLC00519 (Energy Plant, 29.52 ha); APRS states the most recent development plan position switched the site toward mixed use. Coordinates are APRS's stated point for the proposal, not a verified red-line centroid.
